Independent exact suffix/factor occurrence enumeration validates the six support sets and both bounds; this is an exact finite word proof, not a claim about all directives.

value.rationale: The main reason this 44-symbol instance was presented was to refute the universal four-point attractor conjecture. An earlier published October 4 result already supplies an even shorter 36-symbol generalized pseudostandard pseudopalindromic prefix with gamma=5 and a full finite certificate. The new word is different, and its exact gamma value is true, but without a proved extremality, a new bound, a classification, or a reason to require precisely this longer directive, its standalone contribution is an unmotivated second witness. Repackaging the already disproved existential conjecture as another example is insufficient distinct mathematical value.

limitations: One finite length-44 word only; does not establish minimal counterexample length, upper bound on all directives, or classification. Prior 36-word witness already resolves the motivation of refuting the four-attractor conjecture.
